title: Voices and heroes
summary: Colonists speak up when things happen. Sometimes one of them holds the line.
text:
Your colonists talk. When something happens (a birth, a death, a pack beaten, a brownout, a strike, research done, a quiet day) one of them says what they think. Their words show in the log, on their card for a while, and the last few in the Colony panel under **Voices**.

Sometimes one of them does more. When predators tear into a building with people inside, someone may stand and **hold it**: the building takes half damage while they do. If it stands, the deed is theirs for good (★ on their card) and the whole colony is lifted by it. If it falls, that is remembered too.

Tap a name in the log or the panel to find that person.
